scripts.clean: rimraf dist dist-preview bundle compiled node_modules
scripts.dev: bun run ui:build && bun run dev:consumer
scripts.dev:consumer: bun run compile:app && bun run bundle:app && bun ../../harness/newframe/live-harness.ts
scripts.bundle: bun run ui:build && bun run bundle:app
scripts.bundle:app: bun run styles:generate && rimraf bundle && bun build preload/index.ts --outfile=./bundle/bridge.cjs --target=browser --format=cjs --external=electron --sourcemap=inline && bun ./scripts/bundle-renderer-bun.ts && bun ./scripts/check-build-artifacts.ts bundle
scripts.typecheck: bun run ui:build && bun run styles:generate && tsgo --project tsconfig.domain.json && tsgo --project tsconfig.contracts.json && tsgo --project tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsgo --project tsconfig.renderer.json && tsgo --project tsconfig.preload.json && tsgo --project tsconfig.scripts.json && tsgo --project tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.compile: bun run ui:build && bun run compile:app
scripts.compile:app: bun run styles:generate && bun run sync:assets && tsgo --project tsconfig.build.json && bun ./scripts/check-build-artifacts.ts compiled
scripts.compile:watch: bun run ui:build && bun run sync:assets && tsgo --project tsconfig.build.json -w
scripts.build: bun run compile && sleep 4 && bun run bundle && sleep 4 && electron-builder --config=build/electron-builder-standard.cjs
scripts.install:preview: bun run compile && sleep 4 && bun run bundle && sleep 4 && electron-builder --mac --config=build/electron-builder-preview.cjs && bun ./scripts/install-preview.ts
scripts.test:unit: bun run ui:build && bun run ui:test && bun run colors:check && bun run architecture:check && bun run test:main && bun test --isolate --preload ./test/support/bun.dom.ts --timeout 500 ./renderer/state ./renderer/shared/ui ./renderer/shared/hooks && bun test --isolate --preload ./test/support/bun.dom.ts --timeout 500 ./renderer/tray && bun test --isolate --preload ./test/support/bun.dom.ts --timeout 500 ./renderer/sidetray && bun test --preload ./test/support/bun.setup.ts --timeout 1000 ./renderer/shared/link.test.ts ./renderer/shared/format ./domain ./contracts ./preload ./scripts
